title: SQL SSIS Data Analyst - URGENT NEED!
text: SQL SSIS Data Analyst - URGENT NEED! at Ethos BeathChapman (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). We are looking for a SQL SSIS Data Analyst for one of our financial services clients in Sydney CBD. You will have strong SSIS ETL development skills as well as having strong business acumen. In this role, you will be using SSIS to support marketing execution and extract data for campaigns. You will be optimising designs of structures for reporting and analysis. There will be a reporting specialist working alongside you and any reporting skills or understanding of Cognos, Qlik, Excel and/or SPSS will be beneficial but no means essential. The hiring manager needs a strong communicator that is confident in their own ability and proactive. You will be given the responsibility of mentoring internal people for SQL and translating business needs into a data brief. Salesforce is being brought into this environment as a replacement CRM and will be rolled out over the next 18-24 months, so any Salesforce integration experience will be useful but is not essential. Technically, you must be strong in SQL and extraction with SSIS and you must be able to articulate clearly to non-technical people and work with stakeholders across the business, including marketing. You will design and develop solutions to optimise costs and efficiency. SKILLS & EXPERIENCE SQL specialist with strong SSIS skills Data analysis specialist Strong understanding of Data and Systems Strong business acumen and problem solver SQL coding skills across a variety of RDMS platforms Understanding of BI / DW methodology like Kimball and Data Vault Analysis, documentation and reporting skills Useful to have an understanding of reporting tools like Cognos, Excel, Qlik and/or SPSS Financial services or health industry experience is advantageous Strong stakeholder management skills Strong written and verbal communication skills If the above sounds like you, please get in touch. We can wait for a notice period to be served and interviews will commence immediately. It is likely that the hiring manager's preferred candidate will be offered the role after one interview by the end of next week. For further information on this role or to confidentially apply, please contact Rik English on 02 8227 9200 or apply directly via the Apply for this job button. Only WORD FORMAT resumes will be accepted.
